The '''Dar'manda''' was a band of ex-[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|gun runners]] and one of the five ruling organizations on [[Mek-Sha]] after [[Huttbreaker's Rebellion]].

==History==
{{Quote|We're Dar'manda. Don't care about Mando politics, we just like getting paid.|[[Bask Sunn]]|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
[[File:Darmanda.png|thumb|left|220px|Indigo and the Dar'manda on Mek-Sha]]
The group was led by [[Indigo (Mandalorian)|Indigo]]<ref name="CX" /> in [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Date1">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> The Dar'manda were based out of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]], acting as one of the ruling organizations after their role in the [[Huttbreaker's Rebellion]].<ref name="CX" /> During the [[Third Galactic War|renewed conflict]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Mission to Mek-Sha|arrived]] to assist Republic forces and enlisting the help of the space station's lead factions, finding the Dar'manda a possible ally. The Dar'manda offered to cut a deal with the Commander on Mek-Sha but refused to take a side in the renewed conflict off the station. The group was known to have an intense rivalry with another one of Mek-Sha's factions, the [[Harido Wald]], whom the Dar'manda believed was severely squeezing their profits.<ref name="The Gangs of Mek-Sha">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|The Gangs of Mek-Sha|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

[[File:Darmanda62.png|thumb|right|260px|Dar'manda aboard the ''Fortune's Folly''.]]

A [[3626 BBY|year]] later,<ref name="Date2">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> members of the group led by the [[Recruitment officer/Legends|Recruitment officer]] [[Bask Sunn]], joined up with [[Heta Kol]]'s organization known as the [[Hidden Chain]]. They aided Kol with their starship, the ''[[Fortune's Folly]]'', in an [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] on the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'', and helped make off with the [[Clan Cadera banner|banner]] of [[Clan Cadera]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

[[File:Darmanda_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Dar'manda at the Hidden Chain base on Ruhnuk]]
Following the attack on the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'', [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] landed on Mek-Sha and [[Mission to Mek-Sha (Mandalore the Avenger)|took out]] nearly half the Dar'manda trying to discover the whereabouts of Heta Kol, but ultimately came up with nothing. [[Hylo Visz]] remarked in a conversation with the Alliance Commander that Indigo probably didn't even know his people were involved with the Hidden Chain, as he was never a hands-on manager for the group.<ref name="Conflicting Priorities">{{TORcite|type=general|Conflicting Priorities|Odessen}}</ref> Despite them operating without his knowledge, Dar'manda under the Hidden Chain used banners bearing his face.<ref name="TOR:POS">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=daily|Proving Our Strength|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

After the Hidden Chain's escape from Ruhnuk, Heta Kol declared that Dar'manda were no longer part of the Hidden Chain, due to the actions of Bask Sunn during the duel with Shae Vizla.<ref name="old" /> Indigo, who disapproved of Sunn, was happy to learn of his death and decided to use the opportunity to reach out to Sunn's clients.<ref name="MessageBask">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=message|Good news|Indigo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dar'manda first appeared in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion to the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

If Bask Sunn was not killed on Ruhnuk by the Alliance Commander,<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref> then during the Hidden Chain meeting, Heta will inform the others of Bask's actions, and proceed to have the others kill his Dar'manda guards and then throw him out of the airlock, subsequently killing him.<ref name="old" />
